activities.activity_phrase: offers 100 kWh Powerpack for peak shaving, load shifting and demand response
activities.source_sentence: In addition, we offer a 100 kWh Powerpack for peak shaving, load shifting and demand response for commercial customers and for renewable firming and a variety of grid services for utilities.

activities.activity_phrase: begins production of Tesla Energy products at the Gigafactory
activities.source_sentence: We began production of our Tesla Energy products at the Gigafactory in the fourth quarter of 2015.

activities.activity_phrase: pioneers advanced manufacturing techniques for battery packs
activities.source_sentence: We have also pioneered advanced manufacturing techniques to manufacture large volumes of battery packs with high quality and low costs.

activities.activity_phrase: works with lithium-ion cell suppliers to optimize cell designs
activities.source_sentence: We have significant expertise in the safety and management systems needed to use lithium-ion cells in the automotive environment, and have actively worked with lithium-ion cell suppliers to further optimize cell designs to increase overall performance.

activities.activity_phrase: upgrades battery of Model S
activities.source_sentence: For example, in 2015 alone, we upgraded the battery of our lowest range Model S from 60 kWh to 70 kWh, and our highest range Model S to 90 kWh.

activities.activity_phrase: designs battery pack to permit flexibility with respect to battery cell chemistry and form factor
activities.source_sentence: For instance, we have designed our battery pack to permit flexibility with respect to battery cell chemistry and form factor.

activities.activity_phrase: maintains testing and R&D capabilities at the individual cell level, the full battery-pack level, and other critical battery pack systems
activities.source_sentence: We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities at the individual cell level, the full battery-pack level, and other critical battery pack systems.

activities.activity_phrase: evaluates new battery cells as they become commercially viable
activities.source_sentence: We believe that the flexibility of our designs, combined with our research and real-world performance data, will enable us to continue to evaluate new battery cells as they become commercially viable, and thereby optimize battery pack system performance and cost for our current and future vehicles.

activities.activity_phrase: optimizes battery pack system performance and cost for current and future vehicles

activities.activity_phrase: develops a family of drive inverter designs customized to proprietary motor designs
activities.source_sentence: Tesla has developed a family of drive inverter designs that are customized to its proprietary motor designs to most efficiently meet the demands of each of our vehicles.

activities.activity_phrase: designs chargers that convert alternating current into direct current for battery charging
activities.source_sentence: The second function, charging the battery pack, is accomplished by the charger, which converts alternating current (usually from a wall outlet or other electricity source) into direct current that can be accepted by the battery.

activities.activity_phrase: offers a Mobile Connector for multiple charging services
activities.source_sentence: In most markets, Tesla vehicles come with a Mobile Connector that allows for multiple different charging services to be used.

activities.activity_phrase: offers a Tesla Wall Connector for higher power charging
activities.source_sentence: In many markets, Tesla offers a Tesla Wall Connector that can be set up to provide higher power charging than the Mobile Connectors.

activities.activity_phrase: operates a Supercharger network for fast charging

activities.activity_phrase: develops software for vehicle control and infotainment

activities.activity_phrase: equips vehicles with hardware for incremental introduction of autopilot technology

activities.source_sentence: We design and engineer bodies, chassis, interiors, heating and cooling and low voltage electrical systems in house and to a lesser extent in conjunction with our suppliers.

activities.activity_phrase: collects initial payment upon order and remaining payment upon delivery
activities.source_sentence: To begin production or make a reservation, we require an initial payment which is collected once the customer has selected the vehicle specifications and has entered into a purchase agreement.

activities.activity_phrase: diagnoses and remedies vehicle problems remotely via wireless data upload
activities.source_sentence: Our vehicles are designed with the capability to wirelessly upload the data to us via an on-board system with cellular connectivity, allowing us to diagnose and remedy many problems before ever looking at the vehicle.

activities.activity_phrase: offers an eight year, infinite mile warranty for the battery and drive unit on current new vehicles
activities.source_sentence: For the battery and drive unit on our current new vehicles, we offer an eight year, infinite mile warranty, although the battery’s charging capacity is not covered.

activities.activity_phrase: offers a comprehensive maintenance program for every new vehicle
activities.source_sentence: In addition to the New Vehicle Limited Warranty, we offer a comprehensive maintenance program for every new vehicle, which includes plans covering prepaid maintenance for up to eight years or up to 100,000 miles and an Extended Service plan.

activities.activity_phrase: offers an Extended Service plan

activities.activity_phrase: provides customers with a resale value guarantee
activities.source_sentence: Certain of our financing programs provide customers with a resale value guarantee under which those customers have the option of selling their vehicle back to us at a preset future date, generally during the period of 36 to 39 months following delivery for a pre-determined resale value .

activities.activity_phrase: offers residual value guarantees to financial institutions
activities.source_sentence: In certain markets, we also offer residual value guarantees to financial institutions which may obligate us to repurchase the vehicles for a pre-determined price.
